rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Peach Beauty
rows.Origin:
Bred by Eugene S. Boerner (United States, before 1966).
Introduced in United States by Thomasville Nursery Archive - Closed in 1970 as 'Peach Beauty'.
rows.Bloom: Peach - pink. Strong fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Vigorous.
